minor.finding: 'class' is rendered as श्रेणी, but in the existing hi ui.agents.* glossary श्रेणी already means 'tier' (प्रयास श्रेणी = effort tier: ui.agents.detail.read.effort_label, ui.agents.models.override.tier_field, ui.agents.models.reading.tier_layer 'श्रेणी {tier}'), and this branch's own summary.change.effort is 'प्रयास श्रेणी बदली'. Both phrases are joined into the same 'Updated <name> (<kind>):' summary, so 'प्रयास श्रेणी बदली, श्रेणी बदलकर पहल करने वाला की गई' reads as a tier change. The quoted label 'पहल करने वाला' (m., matching ui.agents.refusals.class.label.proactive) also sits unquoted before a feminine verb agreeing with श्रेणी, which reads awkwardly. Meaning is still recoverable from the label words, so not MAJOR. Suggested: follow ui.notices.agents.proactive/reactive, e.g. 'अब पहल कर सकता है' / 'अब सिर्फ़ जवाब देता है — अपनी ओर से संदेश भेजना बंद हुआ', or a distinct noun with the label in quotes. Disposition: recommend fix in remediation wave; non-gating
